title: ERC-8004 registration file extension: humanBacking
description: Optional array on an ERC-8004 registration-v1 file. Each entry points to an on-chain HumanBindingRegistry that can answer isHumanBacked(agentId). Discovery hint only: verifiers must query a registry they trust, never accept the card's word.

bindingRegistry.description: CAIP-10 account id of the HumanBindingRegistry: eip155:<chainId>:<address>

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId in the identity registry named in `registrations`.

trustAnchor.description: Self-reported. The registry's isTestAnchor() is authoritative.
